annotations.title: Scan FAR / DFARS & CMMC Regulatory Flow-Down Clauses

description: Scan solicitation Section I or subcontract flow-down text to identify every FAR (`52.2xx`) and DFARS (`252.2xx`) clause, flag mandatory subcontractor flow-downs, and score CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, and FedRAMP compliance burden. This is a read-only, stateless regulatory audit (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `raw_text` accepts 30 to 100,000 characters, and `contractor_role` adjusts risk severity and flow-down obligations for a 'prime_contractor' [default], 'subcontractor', or 'commercial_item_vendor' under FAR Part 12). Use this tool when performing federal acquisition regulation (FAR/DFARS/CMMC) clause compliance; use `audit_contract_risks` instead for commercial MSA/NDA legal redlining, or `answer_security_questionnaire` to draft control-by-control NIST 800-171 / SOC 2 questionnaire responses.

contractor_role.description: Bidder's contracting tier: 'prime_contractor' (evaluates full agency compliance and outbound flow-down duties), 'subcontractor' (flags over-broad prime flow-downs), or 'commercial_item_vendor' (filters against FAR 52.212-5 commercial item exemptions).

handles_cui_or_cdi.description: Whether the contractor will store, process, or transmit Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) or Covered Defense Information (CDI).

raw_text.description: Solicitation Section I, contract clause list, or subcontract agreement text containing FAR (`52.2xx`) or DFARS (`252.2xx`) citations (30 to 100,000 characters).

name: scan_far_dfars_clauses

compliance_burden_level.description: Categorical compliance burden level (LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, EXTREME_DEFENSE_GRADE).

contractor_role_evaluated.description: The contractor role perspective used for the audit.

cyber_compliance_profile.description: Structured CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, FedRAMP, and cyber incident reporting requirements.

detected_clauses.description: Detailed breakdown of every FAR/DFARS/supplement clause found, with severity, flow-down status, and remediation advice.

ip_and_data_rights_warnings.description: Specific warnings regarding Government Unlimited Rights, GPR, computer software rights (FAR 52.227 / DFARS 252.227), or patent traps.

mandatory_flowdown_count.description: Number of detected clauses that carry mandatory subcontractor flow-down obligations.

overall_compliance_burden_score.description: Overall regulatory and cybersecurity compliance burden score from 0 (minimal commercial burden) to 100 (extreme defense/CMMC/IP burden).

priority_compliance_actions.description: Ordered checklist of immediate pre-proposal actions (e.g., SPRS score verification, CMMC assessment, IP assertion table in Section K/L).

solicitation_summary.description: Concise executive summary of the regulatory posture, agency context, and contract vehicle.

total_clauses_detected.description: Total number of FAR, DFARS, and agency supplement clauses identified.

title: Scan FAR / DFARS & CMMC Regulatory Flow-Down Clauses
